title: Emitted Client (output)
description: An inert generated client. It is written text only — the emitter never evaluates, imports, or executes it, and admitting it as an interface (or running it as a frontend build artifact) is an act the harness performs later, entirely outside this limb.

source_manifest_digest.description: Copied verbatim from the input published-manifest's manifest_digest. Also embedded inside `source` itself, so a caller reading only the generated file (not this wrapper) can still detect drift against a later server manifest.

generated_digest.description: SHA-256 hex digest of `source` itself, for the caller's own cache invalidation. Distinct from source_manifest_digest: this one changes if the emitter's template changes even when the contract does not.
